contract.description: Generate a Mitsubishi GX Works2 list-format PROGRAM CSV (FX2/FX3) from structured rungs. Output matches real GX exports: a 3-row preamble, seven TAB-separated quoted columns, optional line statements and notes, real step numbers, continuation rows for multi-operand instructions, and a trailing END. A line_statement is limited to 64 GX text units (half-width=1, full-width=2); over-limit input is rejected before writing because GX imports it with a warning. Every network needs an execution condition; when an explicit network starts with MOV/ADD/OUT or another enabled instruction, the generator inserts LD M8000 so GX Program Check does not fail with C9322. This import format is only for label-free GX Works2 Simple Projects using device operands such as X0/Y0. The result round-trips through the lint as {ok, csv, diagnostics}; repair the rungs when ok is false. Write the returned csv with write_file; PLC Code writes .csv files as UTF-16LE+BOM with CRLF, so staging and saved files open directly in GX/Excel.

project_name.description: Project name used in the CSV preamble; defaults to the GX placeholder.

rungs.description: Structured rungs: each entry is one instruction row with instruction, operand/operands, and optional line_statement/note.

line_statement.description: Optional 行间声明 row; maximum 64 GX text units (half-width=1, full-width=2). Split longer text across rows.

note.description: 注解 attached to this instruction; emitted as its own follow-on row in the 注解 column.

operand.description: Single operand/device (e.g. X0). For a multi-operand instruction use operands instead.

operands.description: All operands in order for a multi-operand instruction (e.g. MOV: ["K0","D0"]); emitted as instruction row + one continuation row per further operand, like a real export.

contract.name: mitsubishi_csv_generate
